title: Fix the First-Three-Letters Slice
description: The program should print the first three letters of a word. Fix the bug.
expectedBehavior: The program should print 'Pyt', the first three letters.
actualProblem: A slice [0:2] only includes indices 0 and 1, giving just 'Py' — two characters instead of the intended three.
explanation: Slicing with [start:stop] includes start but excludes stop. To capture exactly three characters starting at index 0, the slice must end at index 3.
